title: ALTer — the pro Media Editor for the Mac
description: ALTer is a Mac photo and video library that references your originals instead of absorbing them. Adjustments with a non-destructive, timeline editor, web layers, AI descriptions for photos and video, accessible web galleries, and Bluesky posting with ALT text attached automatically.
tagline: The pro Media Editor for the Mac.
finePrint: Version 1.0 · Free · macOS 13 or later · Apple Silicon & Intel · everything bundled, nothing to install
